info.name: Docusign Gets a list of documents associated with a template.

params.name: accountId
params.description: The external account number (int) or account id GUID.

params.name: templateId
params.description: The ID of the template being accessed.

items.docs: Retrieves a list of documents associated with the specified template.

info.name: Docusign Adds documents to a template document.

params.name: accountId
params.description: The external account number (int) or account id GUID.

params.name: templateId
params.description: The ID of the template being accessed.

params.name: apply_document_fields
params.description:
When **true**, document fields
can be added or modified
while adding or modifying envelope documents.

items.docs: Adds one or more documents to an existing template document.

info.name: Docusign Deletes documents from a template.

params.name: accountId
params.description: The external account number (int) or account id GUID.

params.name: templateId
params.description: The ID of the template being accessed.

items.docs: Deletes one or more documents from an existing template.

info.name: Docusign Gets PDF documents from a template.

params.name: accountId
params.description: The external account number (int) or account id GUID.

params.name: documentId
params.description: The ID of the document being accessed.

params.name: templateId
params.description: The ID of the template being accessed.

items.docs:
Retrieves one or more PDF documents from the specified template.

You can specify the ID of the document to retrieve or can specify `combined` to retrieve all documents in the template as one pdf.

params.name: apply_document_fields

When **true**, document fields
can be added or modified
while adding or modifying envelope documents.

items.docs: Adds the specified document to an existing template document.
